testcase.name: Given a MessageRecord with an attachment, when I enqueueAttachmentsFromStoryForDownload, then I enqueue once
Given a MessageRecord with no attachments and a LinkPreview with a thumbnail, when I enqueueAttachmentsFromStoryForDownload, then I enqueue once
